selected_observations.excerpt: Helion Robotics Ltd is the operating name used in CRM. Invoices and Companies House use Helion Robotics Limited. That is the same legal entity. Helion Industrial Systems Ltd is a different company; it sold sensors to us in 2018 and has no current MSA.
